card.name: The ending -able in treatable, preventable
card.fires_on: The ending "able" on a stem like "treat" or "prevent", forming "treatable" or "preventable". It comes before a noun such as outcome, condition or causes.

modes.label: treatable
modes.description: "able" finishing "treatable" before a condition or outcome noun.
modes.example: Neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome (NOWS) is an expected and treat<<able>> outcome of use of Methadone Hydro

modes.label: preventable
modes.description: "able" finishing "preventable" when talking about deaths or health problems.
modes.example: More than half of all premature deaths among men are prevent<<able>>. We’ll let that sink in for

card.plain: It marks the end of the words treatable and preventable when they describe a condition or outcome.
